entries.description: Quota Check: Your quota against your on-target earnings, judged by what the number is measured in: new bookings, cloud consumption growth, or a whole book.
representativeQueries: is my quota crazy
quota to OTE ratio for cloud sales
is my sales quota fair

entries.description: Quota Case: Find the gap between last year and this year's quota: run rate or ARR, pipeline at your real win rate, headcount, one-time deals. Then push back with it, or close it with growth in existing accounts and net-new ones.
representativeQueries: how to push back on a quota that is too high
is my sales quota realistic compared to last year
find the gap between last year and this year's quota
my quota went up and my territory did not
can my territory make the number

entries.description: Discount Check: How much discount is too much? See what it costs in your commission and the company's margin before you say yes.
representativeQueries: what does a discount cost me in commission
should I give a 15 percent discount
discount impact on margin and commission

entries.description: Update Upward: Write the update a seller or manager sends upward: a weekly note, a forecast call, calling a miss, or a monthly business review.
representativeQueries: how to tell my boss I will miss my number
weekly sales update template for my manager
what to say on a forecast call
monthly business review for sales

entries.description: Pay Check: Base, variable, accelerator, cap and threshold in. What the plan pays at 50% to 200% of quota out, where the upside goes, and the fine print to get in writing.
representativeQueries: how much will my sales comp plan pay at 150% of quota
sales accelerator calculator
does my commission cap limit my upside
what does OTE really pay
comp plan payout curve

entries.description: Commission Check: Deal size, commission rate and your share of the credit in, what you actually take home out, after the share you set aside for taxes.
representativeQueries: how much of my commission do I take home
commission take home after taxes
commission check calculator

entries.description: Offer Check: Your current sales job against a new offer, each at a realistic attainment: what the offer really pays, what year one costs you with the ramp and what you leave behind, and when you come out ahead. Or check one offer on its own.
representativeQueries: is this sales job offer worth it
should I take the sales job offer
current job vs new offer calculator
sales offer OTE vs realistic earnings
sales job offer ramp guarantee

entries.description: Pipeline Check: target, pipeline and win rate in, the gap out. 3X is a rule of thumb; your win rate says what you actually need. Then five questions on the shape: spread, motion, next steps, timing, creation.
representativeQueries: do I have enough pipeline to make my number
pipeline coverage calculator with my win rate
is 3X pipeline coverage enough
how fragile is my pipeline
pipeline concentration and aging risk

entries.description: Rep Check: Is it the rep, the territory, a skill gap or an effort gap? Five questions for sales managers, and how to defend your people in a talent review.
representativeQueries: is it the rep or the territory
why is my sales rep underperforming
rep problem or territory problem
prepare for OLR calibration
will my case for a rep survive talent review

entries.description: Partner Check: Tell the AI version of Mark about a partner, prime, reseller or SI and get a straight read on whether it is real work or promises, tested against sourced deals, a named account, an owner who gets paid, a plan with dates and pull.
representativeQueries: is this partner real or a logo
is my channel partner actually selling
partner check for co-sell

entries.description: Deal Check: five questions (customer, money, power, path, now) that separate proof from hopium in a federal deal, then whether you know the account and why they would pick you.
representativeQueries: is my deal real or hopium
qualify a federal sales deal before commit
what will my manager ask about this deal
do I know the account or just my contact
am I single-threaded in this account

entries.description: Account Plan: Turn what a seller knows about one account into a plan with a number on it: coverage at the win rate, the money by the customer's own quarters, the gaps, who to meet, milestones.
representativeQueries: how to write a sales account plan
account plan template with pipeline coverage
federal account plan by fiscal quarter
strategic account plan for a quota carrier

entries.description: Commit Check: For cloud and consumption sellers: will the customer use their committed spend? See the pace, the monthly spend it takes from here, and the shortfall or overage.
representativeQueries: will my customer burn their cloud commit
committed spend vs actual consumption
EDP commit burn down calculator
customer is behind on their committed spend
how much monthly spend to use a cloud commitment

entries.description: Meeting Prep: Prepare for one important customer meeting, or an internal brief or QBR: the objective, what you know and do not, their likely priorities, questions to ask, objections, landmines and the next step to ask for.
representativeQueries: prepare for an important customer meeting
questions to ask a CIO in a sales meeting
what objections to expect in a customer meeting
how to brief a general officer or SES
meeting prep for enterprise sales

entries.description: Federal Readiness Check: Tell the AI version of Mark what you sell and who in government wants it, and get a skeptical read on whether there is a federal business: customer, money, buying path, partners and team.
representativeQueries: is my company ready to sell to the federal government
federal go-to-market readiness
do I need a prime contractor
how do federal agencies buy software
federal sales readiness checklist
